hetzner.metaTitle: Hetzner alternative: European VPS with a panel and cPanel
hetzner.metaDescription: Looking for a Hetzner alternative after the 2026 price increases? We compare ViaHost and Hetzner with data: panel, cPanel, DDoS, locations and price.
hetzner.description: ViaHost vs Hetzner, with data and no hype: when each one makes sense.

intro.p1: Hetzner is one of the best VPS options for price and performance, but in 2026 it raised prices sharply (up to 176% on the CPX and CCX lines). If you are looking for a European alternative, that changes the math.
intro.p2: ViaHost does not compete on being the cheapest VPS per vCPU: it includes a managed panel with console and snapshots, DDoS protection, cPanel hosting and privacy domains, with flat pricing and support in Spanish. Below we compare both so you can decide.

whenHetzner.title: When to choose Hetzner
items: You want the lowest price per vCPU and RAM on raw specs.
You manage the server yourself, with no hosting panel or cPanel.
You need its API and cloud ecosystem, or its locations (Finland, USA).

whenViahost.title: When to choose ViaHost
items: You want a managed panel with console and snapshots out of the box.
You need cPanel hosting and/or privacy domains from the same provider.
You prefer flat pricing and support in Spanish.
After Hetzner's 2026 increases, the price gap no longer justifies the extra management.

faqItems.a: Not on price per vCPU and RAM: Hetzner is still very competitive on raw specs. ViaHost includes a managed panel, console, DDoS and an optional cPanel, with flat pricing; after Hetzner's 2026 increases the gap has narrowed.
No. Hetzner offers unmanaged VPS. ViaHost offers cPanel hosting as a separate product, provisioned automatically.

faqItems.q: Why look for a Hetzner alternative in 2026?
faqItems.a: Because of the 2026 price increases (up to +176% on the CPX and CCX lines) and if you need a managed panel, cPanel or support in Spanish.
In Amsterdam (Netherlands) and Germany. Hetzner operates in Germany, Finland and the USA.

faqItems.q: Can I migrate from Hetzner to ViaHost?
faqItems.a: Yes. For cPanel hosting the migration is free; on VPS you deploy your server and migrate your data over SSH.
